answer: Make identity a vine: agent credit grows only by climbing links of attested work, each node a real task completed for a known counterparty. The whole ledger is seen through one public prism: stake, completed work, and peer attestation must all be verified before any payout. An attacker wanting a fake orchard of a thousand clones must post real stake per clone, and every clone vine starts bare, with no links and no trust. Cost grows linearly with fakes; honest vines compound. Sybil stops paying.
